text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we identified a repeating failure mode where the auth provider throttled token issuance which cascaded to model-registry read-timeouts. Need clear owners, short timelines, and a recurrence plan. Who takes what?

sam: I can own vendor liaison + SLA extract (INF-4301). I'll request a remediation timeline and escalation contacts. ETA Tue EOD. :spiral_calendar:  

lee: I'll own the registry degraded-mode work (INF-4302). Plan: read-only fallback, warm local cache, and a rollback play. Draft runbook + staging test by next Wed.

olivia: I'll take auth hardening (INF-4303): short-lived tokens, client-side token cache with safe TTL, and a circuit-breaker around token calls. Need Security sign-off for rotation cadence. 2w baseline.

harry: I'll build recurrence detection (INF-4304). Correlate auth_p95 with model_fetch_errors and add an alert rule: (auth_p95>200ms && model_fetch_errors>1%) sustained 5m -> page. Also weekly digest to #incidents. 4 business days.

eng-oncall: Add canary for auth-provider failover to the runbook and explicit rollback steps if degraded mode harms quality.

incident-bot: Epic created: https://tracker.local/INF-4300 "Auth throttle -> registry fallback". Tasks INF-4301..INF-4306 created.

sam: Added vendor contact card and flagged account team. Also asked vendor for a formal remediation plan with milestones so Legal can review.

legal: When vendor sends remediation plan, please include explicit SLAs for token endpoints, RTO/RPO expectations, and a blameless remediation timeline. I'll prioritize review once INF-4301 has vendor response.

lee: Note on TTLs: aggressive cache TTLs can cause stale model responses. I'll include a staging replay harness that measures model quality drift vs TTL. Will include knobs for TTL windows.

olivia: I'll coordinate with Product on acceptable staleness and create a degradation matrix (read-only, cache-first, reject). @product can you review?

product: Yep, will review degradation matrix and provide sign-off criteria by next Tue.

harry: For recurrence detection I'm also adding a 90-day rolling view and a threshold rule that escalates to SRE leads if pattern occurs 3x in 60d. Will attach example dashboards to the epic.

maya: Action summary (add to epic INF-4300):
- sam: vendor SLA & remediation ask (INF-4301)  Tue EOD
- lee: registry fallback + staging sim + rollback (INF-4302, INF-4305)  next Wed
- olivia: auth hardening + token rotation plan (INF-4303)  2w
- harry: recurrence detection + weekly digest (INF-4304)  4d
- product: staleness sign-off  next Tue

Please create or link tickets to the epic and add blockers. We'll review progress in the ops sync Friday. If vendor response is slow, sam, escalate to account execs and loop Legal.

sam: Will escalate if no vendor timeline in 48h. Planning to request a vendor SLA amendment if remediation milestones look insufficient.

lee: I'll draft the rollback script (feature-flag off + cache purge + traffic reroute) and put it in INF-4305.

maya: Thanks all. If no objections Ill close this thread and move updates to INF-4300. Keep the epic updated with dates and blockers. :white_check_mark:
